performance_claim_scope: W7900/gfx1100 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B UD-Q3_K_M BF16-KV 512/128, 1K/128, and 4K/128 resident prefill plus graph decode

8ece5a57 feat: add Q3 selected decode kernels

model.scope: 40-layer autoregressive target; trailing MTP block 40 is not enabled

protocol.prompt: token ID 9707 repeated to the requested length
protocol.session_scope: one independent right-sized resident process per shape
protocol.gpu_idle_gate: card1 gpu_busy_percent <= 2 for three consecutive one-second samples before each process
protocol.prefill: forced production bulk attention, WMMA prefill, GEMV decode enabled
protocol.decode: 128 one-step production HIP graph replays; graph capture excluded from steady decode timing
protocol.build: new IQ library prebuilt outside timing, then --require-cached-build

correctness_evidence.result: 76 focused regressions pass; canonical CPU-oracle agreement at real shapes; all-40-layer eager output finite; eager and graph next token both 513; IQ3 gate/up, IQ4 gate/up, and IQ4 down kernels all report zero scratch
multi-token IQ3/IQ4 CPU-oracle agreement; bulk and serial top-1 both 16 with KL 0.000571618; 512, 1K, and 4K bulk prompts reach exact final positions
733 AR tensors materialize; all 117 IQ expert tensors remain raw compressed blocks; zero IQ dense-BF16 records

baseline.note: The primary comparison matches model file, GPU, workload labels, and date, but remains a HIP-versus-Vulkan and harness comparison. qwen-kernel times prompt_length-1 prefill tokens while hipEngine times the full requested prompt, so the deltas are descriptive rather than a causal backend attribution.

limitations: The correctness-first selected IQ gate/up kernel uses a four-row mapping. Bulk prefill reuses it with rows=tokens*top_k and has no grouped-expert weight reuse, so Q3 prefill does not approach the optimized Q4 path.

IQ3_XXS and IQ4_XS selected-expert weights intentionally remain in raw GGUF layout with no resident IQ repack. Decode therefore does not yet realize the 6.77% ideal active-byte advantage previously calculated for Q3 over Q4.

This baseline covers one W7900/gfx1100 system, BF16 KV, greedy repeated-token traffic, and the 40-layer AR target only. It does not validate gfx1151, RX 7900 XTX, server concurrency, MTP, quality across a prompt corpus, or long context.

The three source sweeps label themselves diagnostic_retained_pending_rollup_gate because the generic README rollup expects a different six-shape publication protocol. This compact artifact accepts only the explicit three-shape local Q3 baseline; the source sweeps and their hashes remain recoverable from merged branch commit d47e63cd rather than the repository tip.
conclusion: Native Q3 execution is correct and reproducibly benchmarkable, but the first correctness-oriented kernels do not reproduce qwen-kernel's decode advantage. qwen-kernel remains 1.49x to 1.75x faster in decode; grouped expert reuse and IQ row-tile/codegen work remain optimization candidates rather than accepted transfers.
